name: São Tomé (São Tomé and Príncipe)
description: A field divided per saltire into blue and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of the city of São Tomé.
history: The flag of the capital, in the Portuguese municipal style of a field divided per saltire with the town arms at the centre. No adoption date has been published.

features.role: arms of the city of São Tomé
